thread:
sasha: Quick sync — I'm assembling inputs for the new routing/quota dashboards and want to align on metric names + cardinality before we wire up the Console. TL;DR: OTel attr names vs Prom labels, and which values are high-cardinality that must be avoided in Prom.

kai: SGTM. Can you list the runtime signals you need? latency/p50/p95, tokens_in, tokens_out, routing_decision? :eyes:

sasha: Yep. From runtime we need: request.latency_ms (p50/p95), request.tokens_in, request.tokens_out, route.decision, model.variant, queue.duration_ms, batch.size. Also need a per-tenant quota_remaining gauge and per-route quota_policy id.

julia: FWIW eng-runtime emits these with OTel attributes like service.name, net.peer.ip, model.name, model.revision. Problem: model.revision and net.peer.ip are high-cardinality. We should avoid putting them as Prom labels.

mike: +1. For Prom we should canonicalize to labels: service, env, model, model_family, route, tenant_id. model_revision -> model_version (only when pinned) and only as label on low-sample metrics (not on high-cardinality counters).

adele: Also consider using an attribute-to-label mapping doc and automated sanitizer in ingest. We had noise from rogue model_revision tags last quarter.

sasha: Proposal draft (short):
```
Prom labels: service, env, region, tenant_id, route, model_family, model_version (optional)
OTel attributes: service.name, deployment.environment, cloud.region, telemetry.tenant_id, routing.rule, model.name, model.revision
High-cardinality DO NOT PROM LABEL: model.revision, request_id, net.peer.ip, user_email
```
Can we get reactions or objections?

kai: :thumbsup: on the list. One ask — can route be stable string or do we need hashed route id? Some routes include user-supplied strings.

julia: We should use route_id (stable generated) as Prom label. Store human route_name as OTel attr for debug but not label.

mike: For quotas: metric name suggestion `quota.remaining{tenant_id, quota_type}` and `quota.consumed_total{tenant_id, quota_type}`. Keep quota_type low-cardinality e.g., daily_embed, monthly_tokens.

adele: Dashboard needs derived series: per-tenant consumption rolling 30d, and top-100 tenants by token consumption. Top-100 is doable in Prom with recording rules + leaderboard. We'll need a job in metrics pipeline to limit cardinality.

sasha: Action items I see: 1) eng-runtime to publish a mapping doc + example telemetry payload (julia) 2) eng-platform to propose Prom label whitelist + sanitizer (kai/mike) 3) devex to update dashboard templates (adele) 4) infra to add recording rules for leaderboards (mike)

julia: I'll drop a sample OTLP JSON in this thread in ~30m.

kai: I'll sketch the sanitizer config and add to the metrics repo PR.

mike: I'm okay to own recording rules and the initial dashboard panels. Can we agree on naming: `runtime_request_latency_ms` and `runtime_request_tokens_total`?

sasha: Yes naming convention: subsystem_metric_unit (snake_case). runtime_request_latency_ms, runtime_request_tokens_total, routing_decision_count (label=decision).

platform-bot: Reminder: Metrics schema review meeting added to calendar Tue 09:30 PT. Invite: @sasha @kai @julia @mike @adele

adele: Great — I'll prepare a dashboard mock and a short notes doc for the meeting.

sasha: Thanks all. If anyone sees an urgent problem with the label list above reply here before EOD. Otherwise I'll publish the mapping doc after the meeting. :white_check_mark:
